country.evidence_quote: Eleonora Romanescu, a representative of the golden generation of fine arts in the Republic of Moldova,revitalizes the artistic heritage through the freshness and intensity of chromatic arrangements based on simultaneous contrasts of an overwhelming aesthetic variety. Being a true poet of colors, the artist shows the same dedication in easel painting and graphics, as well as in the decorative arts – tapestry, as a restorer or pedagogue.
